skills.name: Flying
skills.description: Maneuvering under one's own power (wings) or in zero-gravity; fly meters equal to the Flying die code per round, hover for that many rounds, and in combat Flying can replace Agility when calculating Dodge (excluding the Agility die).

skills.name: Barter
skills.description: A broad skill for trade, business, exchanges, exchange rates, the monetary value of goods, and local financial customs and economics; the Scholar skill of making, spending, and understanding money.

skills.name: Languages
skills.description: Knowing, speaking, understanding, interpreting, and expressing languages both living and dead, representing fluency beyond common speech.
skills.time: usually none (an action when researching or deciphering a lost language)

skills.name: Gambling
skills.description: Playing, teaching, learning, understanding, and cheating at games of strategy and luck, and assessing risk and reward where loss can be significant.

skills.name: Gunnery
skills.description: Attacking with onboard starship weapons; damage is the weapon's die code, and weapon attack bonuses add to the Gunnery roll.

skills.name: Streetwise
skills.description: Finding information, goods, and contacts in large population centers; covers thieves' guilds, crime cartels, black markets, and illicit operations, and helps investigators deduce criminal motives and methods.

vehicles.name: Fighter
vehicles.description: A nimble single-seat combat starship (Defense 10, Hull x5).

vehicles.name: Cargo Transport
vehicles.description: A sturdy hauler built to move goods (Defense 30, Hull x5).

vehicles.name: Smuggler Transport
vehicles.description: A well-rounded transport favored by smugglers (Defense 20).

vehicles.name: Capital Ship
vehicles.description: A massive, heavily armed warship (Defense 35, Hull x5).

powers.name: Energy Defenses
powers.difficulty: Variable (5-20 by energy source; weapon Damage +10 if applied to a weapon)
powers.description: Negate the impact of energy on oneself to ignore harm; exceeding the Difficulty by 5 or more can also turn off or extinguish the energy source. Can be maintained against continuous energy with continual tests.

powers.name: Harm
powers.difficulty: 5 (+5 per use in the last 24 hours, cumulative; plus range penalties)
powers.description: Immediately make a Damage roll against a target using the character's Kinesis die code.

powers.name: Physical Enhancement
powers.difficulty: 5 (+5 per use in the last 24 hours, cumulative)
powers.description: Gain the Kinesis die code as a bonus on the character's next Agility or Brawn die code.

powers.name: Telekinesis
powers.difficulty: 5 for a small handheld object under 1 lb; +5 at 10 lbs, +5 at 100 lbs, +5 at 1000 lbs, +5 per 1000 lbs over (cumulative)
powers.description: Lift, move, levitate, or throw an object with the mind. A thrown object's Damage roll equals the activation Difficulty. The object can be maintained without further rolls until the character takes a die-code action, which ends the power.

powers.name: Trance
powers.description: Fall into a deathlike trance (Difficulty 25 to tell if alive), consuming little energy or food and adding the Perceive die code to rolls resisting environmental effects; on life support the character could live indefinitely. A wake trigger is set on activation, and being Wounded automatically wakes the character.

powers.name: Enhance Perception
powers.difficulty: 5 (+5 per use in the last 24 hours, cumulative)
powers.description: Add the Perceive die code to all perception die codes for 10 minutes.

powers.name: Telepathy
powers.difficulty: 5 (+10 if the target is unfriendly, hostile, or resistant)
powers.description: Read the surface thoughts of a visible living target and understand what it is sensing; exceeding the Difficulty by 10 probes deeper into subconscious or repressed thoughts.

powers.name: Sense Living Form
powers.difficulty: 5 (+5 per use in the last 24 hours, cumulative)
powers.description: Sense the presence, rough location (within ~5 yards), emotional state, health, and basic identity of living beings within 100 yards; beings with a higher Perceive die code get an opposed roll to avoid detection. Can be kept on with a Difficulty 5 action each round.

powers.name: Withstand Harm
powers.difficulty: 5 (+5 if wounded, +5 if incapacitated, +5 if mortally wounded; cumulative to 20)
powers.description: Act as if not incapacitated, wounded, or mortally wounded. Using this power imposes no multi-action penalty, though the character still suffers die penalties for being harmed.

powers.name: Enhance Other
powers.difficulty: 5 (+5 per use in the last 24 hours, cumulative)
powers.description: The target gains the psionic character's Reform die code as a bonus to their next die code rolled. May not be used on oneself.

powers.name: Healing
powers.difficulty: 5 (+5 per use in the last 24 hours, cumulative)
powers.description: Immediately make a Medicine roll applied to oneself, adding the Reform die code as a bonus to the Medicine die code to remove harm.

powers.name: Purge Poison
powers.difficulty: 5 (gamemaster may add difficulty based on the strength of the poison)
powers.description: Immediately remove and purge all poisons and toxins from one's own system.

powers.name: Suggestion
powers.difficulty: Opposed by the target's Willpower (or Knowledge if the Charm module is not used)
powers.description: Impart a brief, easy-to-understand suggestion (a glance, a distraction). The target will not risk itself, and an implausible suggestion is quickly recognized as false.

powers.name: Heal Other
powers.difficulty: 5 (+5 per use in the last 24 hours, cumulative)
powers.description: Make a Medicine roll applied to a target, adding the Reform die code as a bonus to the Medicine die code to remove harm. May not be used on oneself.

powers.name: Purge Poison Other
powers.difficulty: 5 (gamemaster may add difficulty based on the strength of the poison)
powers.description: Immediately remove and purge all poisons and toxins from a target's system. May not be used on oneself.

powers.name: Place Other in Trance
powers.description: Force a target into a Trance (as the Trance power, with all its rules). The awakening trigger is chosen by the target, not the caster, so an enemy cannot be trapped with no way to wake.

powers.name: Cryokinesis
powers.description: Deal a Damage roll equal to the Kinesis+Reform die code to a visible target as a frozen burst of cold; cold defenses and special abilities apply. Can be used to break items or equipment instead of dealing damage.

powers.name: Electrokinesis
powers.description: Deal a Damage roll equal to the Kinesis+Reform die code to a visible target as a supercharged burst of electricity; electrical defenses apply. Can be used to break items or equipment instead.

powers.name: Pyrokinesis
powers.description: Deal a Damage roll equal to the Kinesis+Reform die code to a visible target as a super-heated burst of fire; heat defenses apply. Can be used to break items or equipment instead.

powers.name: Precognition
powers.difficulty: 15 (increased by distance to the location and distance in the timeline)
powers.description: View and sense a chosen locale as though present at some future point. The future is not locked, so events almost certainly will not unfold exactly as seen, but the insight can help build a plan. Can be maintained without rolling while taking no other actions.

powers.name: Postcognition
powers.difficulty: 15 (increased by distance to the location and distance in the timeline)
powers.description: View and sense a chosen locale as though present at some past point. Can be maintained without rolling while taking no other actions or suffering damage.

powers.name: Projected Self
powers.difficulty: 5 (+5 if the character is not within sight of the target, +5 if unable to communicate, +5 if the target is unwilling or resistant; cumulative)
powers.description: Reach out and appear as a wavering ghostly figure near a target to communicate with it; normal communication hurdles (language, etc.) still apply. The projecting character receives no sensory input beyond what is needed to communicate.

powers.name: Farsight
powers.description: View and sense a chosen locale as though present there. Can be maintained without rolling while taking no other actions or suffering damage.

creatures.name: Hacker
special: Represents a computer technician rather than a combat hacker; the gamemaster may add a weapon or cyberware, which this profile does not include.
creatures.description: A skilled computer technician who breaks into networks and systems.

creatures.name: Killer Robot
special: Damage: choose one sci-fi melee weapon and one sci-fi ranged weapon
Robot: a digital and mechanical marvel, not a living being; does not heal normally and must be repaired (Use/Repair Technical due to complexity)

templates.name: Engineer
templates.description: A starship and systems specialist who keeps everything running. Dodge 15, Parry 15. Recommended skills: Communications, Navigation, Piloting, Use/Repair Mechanical.

templates.name: Gunslinger
templates.description: A quick-drawing frontier shooter. Dodge 15, Parry 25. Recommended skills: Intimidation, Shooting, Sleight of Hand, Stealth.

templates.name: Hacker
templates.description: A cybernetic infiltrator who breaks into systems. Dodge 15, Parry 15. Recommended skills: Computers, Sciences, Use/Repair Technical, Upgrade.

templates.name: Medic
templates.description: A field healer and doctor. Dodge 10, Parry 10. Recommended skills: Medicine, Sciences, Use/Repair Mechanical, Use/Repair Technical.

modules.name: Starships & Starship Combat
modules.summary: Starships have four die-code attributes (Navicomp, Maneuverability, Engines, Hull) plus a minimum Crew, weapons, and shields. Interstellar travel needs a Difficulty 15 Navigation roll then a Difficulty 15 Computers roll (rushable to 25), with mishaps on a Wild Die 1. Combat uses normal rules: Gunnery to attack, Hull x5 for Defense, opposed Engines rolls for range, Piloting+Maneuverability to evade, and Hull+Shields to resist damage; ships must be repaired rather than healing.

modules.name: Driving & Vehicles
modules.summary: Ground and air vehicles use two die-code attributes (Maneuverability and Hull) plus a Passenger capacity, weapons, and armor. The Driving skill handles movement and Repair Mechanical maintains them. Combat mirrors starship combat: Gunnery to attack, Hull x5 for Defense, Driving+Maneuverability to evade, and Hull+Armor to resist damage.

modules.name: Psionics
modules.summary: Three stand-alone psionic skills with no governing attribute (Kinesis, Perceive, Reform) must each be trained separately, gaining only the first die through study. Powers are grouped by skill or combined-skill die code; using a power is an action against a Difficulty, and a character knows every power for the skills they possess.

modules.name: Cyberpunk
modules.summary: A cinematic hacking system where the Computers skill is rolled against a target's Firewall (a Difficulty, or Technical x5 for characters); failing by 5+ can draw consequences from an enemy hacker. Cyberware is built on the Perks, Flaws, and Talents module: a Talent declared cybernetic, limited to a number equal to Knowledge, installed via a Medicine roll (Difficulty 10, +5 per existing implant), and hackable at Rank x5 Firewall.

modules.name: Scale
modules.summary: Size differences are ranked 0-6 (Human to super space station). A larger participant adds its Scale bonus (e.g. +1D to +6D) to damage and to Brawn rolls resisting damage; a smaller participant adds its Scale bonus to Dodge defense and to attack die codes against a larger target. Scale rank is a communication tool with no inherent rules effect on its own.
